text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober! Thank you for that
amaaazing race!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Great job, Dober! You were incredible
today!
You're the coolest!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You've grown, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: As for what awaits you next...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I've stopped shaking.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(That's not all. I can hear the audience's
voices
clearly too...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(And even though I just finished a race, I
feel like
I'm bursting with energy!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I've... I've never felt this way before!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
O-oh my gosh! Do you see that?!
Dober's smiling
so wide!

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text: Oh man... I'm gonna cry...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head out to see Mejiro Dober after her
fantastic
run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I did!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Look, I've stopped shaking. And not
only that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I feel so excited right now!
I've never felt
like this
before!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm already looking forward to pushing
myself to
my limits in the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober seems like she's really
matured.
She's accepted her fear and
moved past it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I want to take this feeling and
bring it to
the Shuka Sho as well!
choice_data_list: Let's run an even better race at t...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to do my best...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So you have to keep believing in me like
you
have up to now, okay?
